candidate_relations.reason: Familial Mediterranean fever can cause recurrent abdominal pain and fever but does not identify the recurrent nonperforation free intraperitoneal air diagnosed as spontaneous pneumoperitoneum.
Antiphospholipid syndrome does not account for the documented recurrent, conservatively resolving pneumoperitoneum without visceral perforation.
Gastrointestinal disorder is nonspecific and omits the required diagnosis of spontaneous pneumoperitoneum.
